evidence: task/tests/test.sh is byte-identical to the frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/test.sh (diff empty), so it is template-controlled. Each launch assumption maps to a public statement: (1) entry `if [[ ! -f /app/server.js ]]` and `node "$APP_ENTRY"` <- instruction.md 'Put the application in /app ... It must start with node /app/server.js' and integration.md 'The process starts from /app/server.js'. (2) PORT="3000" and probes http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health then / <- instruction 'listen on port 3000 (honour PORT if it's set), expose GET /api/health as a check that never touches the database'; integration.md 'listens on port 3000 on 0.0.0.0' (127.0.0.1 probe reaches a 0.0.0.0 or loopback bind). Probe accepts any HTTP status, so no hidden response-shape demand. (3) DB_PATH="$APP_DB" (/app/app.db, or /tmp/submission/app.db only if uid 65534 cannot write /app after test.sh's own chown) <- instruction 'keep its durable data in /app/app.db, honouring DB_PATH when that is set'. (4) env -i with only PATH, NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules, HOME, PORT, DB_PATH <- integration.md 'Express and better-sqlite3 already available through NODE_PATH; use only those packages and Node built-ins' and instruction 'Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages'; tests/Dockerfile installs express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 globally, matching environment/Dockerfile pins; no other env var is assumed. (5) Seed: test.sh injects no seed; instruction says '/assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime. Load the supplied ... once, start with no shipped database, and keep new work across restarts' and 'Copy what you need into /app', so an app relying on /assets at runtime was explicitly warned. (6) Symlink refusal (exit 0 for any link outside /app/node_modules or resolving outside it) <- integration.md 'Symbolic links are supported only inside /app/node_modules, and their resolved targets must also stay inside /app/node_modules' (task-added paragraph absent from the template note, closing what would otherwise be a hidden rule). (7) Restart helper relaunches the same entry/DB_PATH <- instruction 'keep new work across restarts' and integration.md 'Restarting the process over the same database file keeps all data, and seeding never duplicates records'. (8) Unprivileged uid 65534 launch: test.sh chowns /app (or the copy) to 65534 before launch, so the stated DB location is writable; no undisclosed write location is required. (9) ~30 s readiness window (120 x 0.25 s): integration.md 'GET /api/health answers before database work can block startup' covers it. (10) Judge URL http://localhost:3000 appears in all 5 prompts and app_context.md; accounts and password Hireops!2026 in app_context.md match instruction.md exactly; app_context forbids assuming reference routes, so no non-public route is imposed. REWARDKIT_* checks concern task.toml [verifier.env], not the agent. Sign-in is publicly specified (accounts and password in the brief), so the workbook's login annotation does not even arise. Counterexample attempts: a broken app that ignores DB_PATH but writes /app/app.db would still launch, but that is leniency, not a contract mismatch (persistence is graded by the judges). Conforming alternatives tried mentally: app binding 127.0.0.1 or 0.0.0.0 (both probed OK); app resolving files via __dirname or absolute /app paths (both work; copy fallback only when /app unwritable and /app still exists); app with node_modules real files under /app (allowed); TypeScript/build-step app (excluded publicly by 'start with node /app/server.js'); app needing NODE_ENV or other env (not promised, and not assumed). None fails for an unstated reason. Golden corroboration: solution bootstrap.js listens on Number(process.env.PORT||3000) at 0.0.0.0 and answers /api/health before DB work; db.js honours DB_PATH and reads seed from its own copy; raw evidence index (hashes verified) records scripted golden runs as uid 65534 with a real restart in the verifier image. Limits: no full configured test.sh/RewardKit launch was observed by this reviewer; this row is a source-level contract comparison and does not require that measurement, which is owned by the separate runtime records.
